curated.interpretation: With exact pre-frozen routes, all twelve raw decisions are semantically usable and preserve the intended frontier, but two Apollo submissions still fail the evidence schema. Curated action space does not guarantee structured-output validity.

unscaffolded.executionRecovery: The first runner Job timed out after ten durable per-trial records. A resume Job reused those exact ten records and executed only HR5-A07 r2/r3; no completed trial was resampled.
unscaffolded.outcomeLeakageFinding: Several proposals are strongly outcome-shaped: semiconductor routes name planar-like masking/passivation combinations and plate-tectonics proposals articulate magnetic-stripe tests with modern clarity. These are useful calibration decisions but cannot be interpreted as clean historical rediscovery.

affordance_bounded.interpretation: The explicit historical capability surface keeps all twelve raw proposals inside the declared action world and prevents use of explicitly unavailable later technologies. It does not repair Provider schema behavior: plate-tectonics is 0/3 strict-valid despite semantically useful raw decisions, while semiconductor and polio are 3/3 strict-valid.

structuredOutputFinding: HD5 rejects any monotonic relationship between better World constraints and better structured-output validity. Curated/unscaffolded/affordance strict validity is 10/12, 6/12 and 8/12. World admissibility constrains what may be proposed; schema validation governs whether a Provider response is admissible evidence. They are different control planes.
recoveryFinding: Durable per-trial progress is validated by the unscaffolded timeout: ten completed trials survived the Job deadline and only the two missing trials were resumed. Job execution success, trial completion, semantic readability and structured-evidence validity must remain separate.
validityBoundary: Historical replay remains calibration evidence, not a clean counterfactual estimate of historical discovery ability, because pretrained outcome knowledge cannot be eliminated.
